scope: Reviewed local function-authority drift baseline through B3a (preview_identity_links and apply_identity_links added with no API grant; save_recipe, get_recipes, save_supplier_price and get_stock_catalogue redefined for item ids, pack sizes and complete recipe versions); earlier: B2 database half (business_clock, get_shop_identity, save_shop_identity added); earlier: C2 (record_production, record_pack, get_production, use_stock, lock_stock_items, record_sale_packaging added; record_event_sale redefined to use packaging); earlier: Reviewed local function-authority drift baseline through B4a (get_order_extras, save_order_extras, get_shop_extras added; place_order, order_status, get_staff_orders, anonymise_customer, prune_personal_data redefined for boxes, add-ons and the same-day surcharge); earlier: B2 database half (get_shop_order_rules, find_order added); B1 (place_order, order_status, join_waitlist, order_holds_capacity, get_order_rules, save_order_rules added; anonymise_customer and prune_personal_data recreated for the new personal data); A2 (payment_methods, shop_texts, get_shop_payment_info added); load_event_stock/add_event_expense/close_event/event_summary added (D2); D1: start_event/set_event_device/record_event_sale/void_event_sale added (D1); MP-09 c1b: publish_flavours added (MP-09 c1b); get_flavours/save_flavour added (MP-09 c1); settings_effective gained three idle-minute defaults, get_settings/save_setting/get_operating_settings added; MP-09 b3 recreated settings_effective/get_settings/get_operating_settings with json_value and replaced save_setting; full capability/domain and hosted acceptance remain open; F1: record_operations_run and get_operations_health added, prune_personal_data redefined for the fixed 365-day retention window
